title: Transport-Constrained Candidate Relation Residual Learning for UAV Visible–Infrared Object Detection
description: Candidate relation residual learning for UAV visible–infrared rotated object detection. The software includes local bipartite candidate graphs, entropic transport with unmatched nodes, weighted candidate relation residual projection, continuous and probabilistic detection heads, training, inference, evaluation, and experiment configurations.
